subject: NeuraHealth: one-time GPU-class uplift and surge-guard signoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Craig Bennett <craig@neurahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: NeuraHealth: one-time GPU-class uplift and surge-guard signoff

Hi Lauren / Karthik —

Quick summary: NeuraHealth is asking for a temporary uplift of their dedicated GPU classification for the upcoming Q3 pilot window and a short overage buffer (what they’re calling a “surge-guard”) while they migrate models. Key asks from Neura:

- Move 8 reserved units from standard a4-family to Pulsar80-equivalent (higher memory/FP throughput) for a 6-week window starting 2028-04-01
- Add a surge-guard of 25% on top of committed capacity with capped overage rate at $18/hr per device for the term window
- One-time 10% concession on committed rate as an incentive to sign the addendum this quarter
- A short reservation hold on the April slot until they confirm their migration schedule (expected by 2028-03-20)

Attached: NeuraHealth_Dedicated_Addendum_Q3.pdf (proposed language) and usage_projection_q3.xlsx.

Why we’re asking exec signoff: the Pulsar80-equivalent SKU is outside our standard committed classification and the 10% concession + capped overage is outside deal desk thresholds. Neura is at CTO-level engagement and wants a quick answer to finalize procurement.

Requested action: Lauren — can you sign off on the uplift + surge-guard as drafted (or indicate changes)? If yes, please confirm any limits (timebox, max discount). Karthik — please note the billing and subscription implications if we agree; I’ll coordinate DocuSign with the Neura procurement contact.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: NeuraHealth_Dedicated_Addendum_Q3.pdf (PDF, 210KB), usage_projection_q3.xlsx (XLSX, 95KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Craig Bennett <craig@neurahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NeuraHealth: one-time GPU-class uplift and surge-guard signoff

Vanessa — thanks for the concise brief. I’ve reviewed the addendum and am willing to approve a limited, conditional exception with the following constraints: 

- Approve Pulsar80-class uplift for a maximum of 6 weeks starting no earlier than 2028-04-01, subject to confirmed migration dates by 2028-03-20.
- Reduce the requested concession: approve up to a 5% one-time discount (not 10%).
- Surge-guard buffer approved at 20% (not 25%) with capped overage rate at $18/hr but limited to 6-weeks and strictly tracked in Console for token-cost anomalies.
- Reservation hold OK for up to 14 days while Neura finalizes schedule; beyond that, we will release capacity.

Two conditions before I’ll sign the addendum:
1) Legal needs to sign off on the updated contract language for the uplift and the overage cap (please run the attached addendum past Legal).
2) Karthik, we need a billing assurance note: ensure we can meter and cap overage by device and provide weekly cost reports to Neura during the uplift period.

If those two items are confirmed, I’ll provide exec signoff by end of day 2028-01-10.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Craig Bennett <craig@neurahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NeuraHealth: one-time GPU-class uplift and surge-guard signoff

Thanks Lauren — understood and noted. Karthik, can you confirm by EOD that: 

- Billing can cap overage at $18/hr per device and produce a weekly overage report to Neura during the uplift window;
- Legal review can be completed by 2028-01-10 (I’ve looped the Legal request into the addendum doc comments).

If both items are green, I’ll prepare the doc for DocuSign reflecting the 5% concession and 20% surge-guard buffer, and send to Craig for signature.

Craig — small heads up: if we get final internal signoff, you’ll receive a DocuSign with the addendum and updated invoice schedule. Can you confirm Neura can sign within three business days? That cadence will let us hold the April slot.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/NEURA-17
From: Craig Bennett <craig@neurahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NeuraHealth: one-time GPU-class uplift and surge-guard signoff

Vanessa / Lauren / Karthik — thanks for the quick turn. Neura can accept the revised terms: 5% one-time concession, 20% surge-guard buffer, $18/hr capped overage and the 6-week window. We will aim to sign within three business days once Legal sends the DocuSign.

A couple of asks from our side: 
- Please add a bullet to the addendum that we receive weekly overage usage reports and that any overage credits disputed by Neura will be reviewed within 5 business days.
- Can you confirm the invoice timing? We prefer overage invoicing monthly, with usage shown per-device.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to getting this over the line.

—Craig Bennett
CTO (acting), NeuraHealth
Craig.Bennett@neurahealth.com
NeuraHealth Procurement: procurement@neurahealth.com
